Mira K.: Alex — can you paste the partner contact and what they need?
Alex R.: Ok team — MirrorKit reseller asked for a joint POC next week. They need SSO + VPC connectivity + pricing floor. Can we map blockers?
Sam B. (Sales): Timeline? expected qps/usage?
Alex R.: They said ~200 qps peak, mostly embedding calls. Pilot 30 days. Want estimated cost + recommended model variants.
Jordan P. (Eng): 200 qps embeddings -> probably Dedicated or burst capacity. Need customer CIDR for peering and sample SAML metadata. Can we get ACS and entityID?
Alex R.: @Jordan P. sent via email earlier: ACS: https://mirrorkit.test/saml/acs  entityID: urn:mirror:prod  Also they want prefix caching; confirm model support for quantized embedding models.
Jordan P. (Eng): We support quantized ada-like embeddings. For VPC peering: please add egress IPs to their firewall: 34.82.10.0/24, 35.201.5.0/24. Also block outbound port 25 from the tenant.
ops-bot: staging-tenant-provisioner: created staging tenant mirrorkit-stg-2026 and emailed creds to alex@mirrorkit.com :thumbsup: 
Lisa H. (Legal): Questionnaire submitted — two flags: data residency (they asked EU-only) and indemnity cap. Need answers before SOW.
Alex R.: They prefer EU-only for pilot. Is Private deployment required or can we do region-limited hosted?
Jordan P. (Eng): Region-limited hosted ok if we pin to eu-west-1 and disable cross-region backups. That should satisfy residency for pilot. Prod would likely need Private.
Sam B. (Sales): Pricing: estimate for 200 qps embeddings for 30 days + canary Dedicated reservation?
Jordan P. (Eng): Rough ballpark: small Dedicated pool + bandwidth ~ $8k for the 30d pilot. I'll get finance a tighter calc.
Alex R.: Action items: Jordan — provide final egress IPs and peering steps; Mira — run SAML test and own runbook; Lisa — propose legal carve for pilot; Sam — draft pricing by EOD. @Mira K. can you create a runbook doc?
Mira K.: Will do. Creating doc: https://redwood.docs/poc/mirrorkit-runbook. Checklist: tenant creds, SAML test, peering steps, sample curl; will add timeline.
Jordan P. (Eng): Sample curl for embeddings:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/embeddings" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"embed-small-quant","input":"hello"}'
```
Alex R.: MirrorKit asked for compliance questionnaire responses — can someone own this? They need it back tomorrow.
Lisa H. (Legal): I'll own it. Send latest certs + SOC link and security contact.
Sam B. (Sales): MirrorKit legal also requested SLA numbers — can we provide 99.9% for pilot or only for Dedicated?
Jordan P. (Eng): Hosted = no formal SLA; Dedicated = SLA for latency/uptime. For pilot we can commit to best-effort and propose Dedicated for prod with SLA.
Alex R.: Thanks. I'll coordinate partner AM and update them. Any immediate blockers? :eyes:
Mira K.: No infra blockers. I'll start the runbook and ping when the staging SAML test passes.
